name: Entity Hierarchy Trash Support
description: Trash (soft-delete) support for Entity Hierarchy: reparents children when a hierarchy parent is trashed.
project_description: Extends Entity Reference Hierarchy (entity_hierarchy) to work with the Trash module's soft-delete model. When an entity is moved to trash the delete hooks other modules rely on are not fired, so entity_hierarchy's tree-maintenance would normally be skipped. This module hooks entity_update, detects a trash operation (a content entity whose 'deleted' field is set) and runs entity_hierarchy's tree-maintenance so the trashed parent's children are moved up to their grandparent (or to root). The trashed entity keeps its own parent reference so the hierarchy can be reconstructed on restore. No configuration, routes, permissions or plugins are provided; installing the module and its dependencies (entity_hierarchy 5.x and Trash) is all that is required.
